mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following a low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 60-day windows when UNRATE is above 8%.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing payroll growth combined with rising unemployment indicates a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 20-day windows when PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth indicates strong supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 60-day windows when INDPRO is growing.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 5-day windows when HOUST is above 700.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate combined with high GDP growth indicates strong economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 20-day windows when FEDFUNDS is low and GDPC1 is high.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days, except in late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 60-day windows when UNRATE is low.
